_doc: CAD switch number (tools/make_key_dxf.load_keys order, 1-46) -> KBFirmware key id in firmware/46es_kbfirmware.json. Matched from the layer-0 legends (QWERTY order per physical row) and the 1.25u / 2u widths; diagrams.py checks that it is one-to-one and that each firmware row runs left to right in CAD X. The firmware display layout does not say whether switch 10 or 11 is Esc; that pair is unverified until compared with the wired r2.
